articles.title: Saudi Arabia warns of potential danger in Yanbu oil hub as Houthi attacks continue
articles.description: Nov 5 - Saudi Arabia issued alerts on Thursday warning of potential danger in Yanbu, the kingdom's Red Sea oil export hub, as Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis continue attacks on the kingdom that have opened another front in the US-Israeli war on Iran. Read more at straitstimes.com.
